parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: B1: Starting on the left, apply one correct double-angle rewrite, e.g. fourth powers via $(1\pm\cos2\theta)/2$ or $4\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta=\sin^22\theta$. B1: Obtain an equivalent intermediate expression such as $\cos2\theta-\sin^22\theta$. B1: Use $\sin^22\theta=1-\cos^22\theta$ and simplify to the given result. Printed alternative expansions from either side accepted exactly as set out. Total 3.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: M1: Form and solve a quadratic in $\cos2\alpha$, $\cos^22\alpha+\cos2\alpha-1=0$; alternative quadratic $\tan^4\alpha+4\tan^2\alpha-1=0$. A1: Obtain $25.9^\circ$ or $154.1^\circ$ (allow 154). A1: Obtain both and no others; radians treated as a misread. Total 3.
